title: ‘WARRIORS OF THE WORD’ - DECIPHERING LYRICAL TOPICS IN MUSIC AND THEIR CONNECTION TO AUDIO FEATURE DIMENSIONS BASED ON A CORPUS OF OVER 100,000 METAL SONGS
reasoning: The paper uses Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) to identify typical topics in metal music lyrics, one of which is 'religion and satanism'. While it identifies religious themes within a corpus, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethics as a core component; it is a musicological study focusing on the correlation between text topics and audio features.
